SunFi Technology Limited Graduate Internship Details

The SunFi is a Nigerian technology-enabled solar financing company dedicated to accelerating the adoption of clean energy in West Africa by making quality solar installations affordable and accessible for businesses and homes.

Founded by former Google engineer Oluyemi Orimogunje, the company provides structured financing options, including pay-as-you-go, subscription plans, and loans, through partnerships with trusted solar installers and financial institutions.

SunFi Technology Limited Graduate Internship is offering User Services Intern works within the User Services unit of SunFi.

The objective of the User Services team is to deliver quality services to our users via the SunFi platform as well as offline. User services achieve these objectives through continual engagement and feedback from our users.
